Name: Reset editor camera
Description: Reset the current Gummi or Teeny Ship editor view through the native transition. Available while editing or in preview after other view transitions finish. A view already at its baseline can stay unchanged.
RestoreBehavior: One-time native view operation. Normal editor input and view reset may replace the result. Disconnect does not undo it. Profiles cannot replay it.

Evidence.Finding: RCX=current camera, EDX=10. Native reset uses 20 transition units and current edit/preview baseline.
Evidence.Level: Complete native IDA assembly and original bytes; isolated owner, numeric and callout tests. No live editor validation.

Name: Preview horizontal FOV
Description: Set the preview camera horizontal field of view once. Enter the editor preview first. The 20–90 degree range matches native zoom input; normal zoom and reset remain active.
RestoreBehavior: One-time native view operation. Normal editor input and view reset may replace the result. Disconnect does not undo it. Profiles cannot replay it.

Evidence.Finding: RCX=camera+16, XMM1=radians, R8D=0. Native zoom clamps to 20–90 degrees.
Evidence.Level: Complete native IDA assembly and original bytes; isolated owner, numeric and callout tests. No live editor validation.

Name: Editor phase
Description: Current validated editor phase: 1 is editing and 4 is preview. Other or detached editor phases are unavailable.
RestoreBehavior: Fresh diagnostic value; no game writes.

Evidence.Finding: Current editor+12276 with matching active editor task and camera mode.
Evidence.Level: Complete native IDA assembly and original bytes; isolated owner, numeric and callout tests. No live editor validation.
